findings.finding: The FY27 bar of £21m revenue implies H2 revenue of only c.£10.15m against H1's pre-released £10.85m, while the last two years ran H2 above H1 (FY26 H1 £8.21m vs H2 c.£9.0m; FY25 £8.54m vs c.£9.2m). Since the guide was reiterated, the US Federal development PO doubled from £0.52m to £1.04m. Together these leave room for an 'ahead of' or 'comfortable with' line. Partly offset: H1 carried perpetual licence revenue deferred from H2 FY26 (the c.$3.6m April upsell), so H2 may genuinely run lighter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide cut 17 Mar 2026: -19.6%. In-line reiteration with strong H1 on 8 Oct 2026: -1.5%. Contract and trading upgrades in Apr 2024 and Apr 2025: +13.1% and +9.0%
findings.why_not_priced: One analyst (the house broker, Cavendish) and forecasts left unchanged on 8 Oct (Stockopedia). The stock went to 158p and back to 145p, which looks like a run-up that faded rather than a priced upgrade. A priced upgrade would show broker forecasts moved above £21m/£5.0m, and none has been found.
